title.narrative: New Masculinity and Gender Program in Bolivia through ADH
Ny Maskulinitetsprogram i Bolivia genom ADH

description.narrative:
Insatsen syftar till att anpassa och genomföra Maskulinitet program för att förebygga våld mot kvinnor i Bolivia. Resultaten kommer att användas för att utveckla program- och policyrekommendationer för att bättre engagera män och pojkar för att uppnå kvinnors fulla ekonomiska, sociala och politiska jämlikhet och för att bidrag till att förebygga våld mot kvinnor. För att omvandla genomgripande könsskillnader i Bolivia är det nödvändigt att utveckla djupare forskning och förståelse för mäns attityder och övertygelser, liksom normer och beteenden, när det gäller jämställdhet. Vidare syftar projektet till att stärka lokala partners kapacitet för att genomföra ett effektivt arbete med män för jämställdhet. Programmet kommer att genomföras i tre regioner i Bolivia och utveckla kapacitetsbyggande tillsammans med metodutveckling och nätverks uppbyggande.
Acción por los Derechos Humanos är en känd Boliviansk organisation med många års erfarenhet av forskning om maskulinitet i Bolivia.
Insatsen bedöms bidra till hållbarhetsmål 5 Jämställdhet samt Bolivias Patriotiska Agenda. Vidare bedöms insatsen bidra till strategin för Sveriges utvecklingssamarbete med Bolivia 2021–2025.

The initiative aims to adapt, and perform the masculinity approach in Bolivia. The projects aims also engage men and boys to achieve women's full economic, social and political equality and to contribute to the prevention of violence against women. In order to transform radical gender differences in Bolivia, it is necessary to develop deeper research and understanding of men's attitudes and beliefs, as well as norms and behaviors in terms of gender equality. Furthermore, the project aims at strengthening local partners capacity to carry out effective work with men for gender equality. The program will be implemented in three regions in Bolivia implementing capacity building along with method development and networking.
Acción por los Derechos Humanos is a renowned Nacional organization with many years of experience in research on masculinity.
The effort is expected to contribute to sustainability goals 5 Equality and Bolivia's Patriotic Agenda. Furthermore, the initiative is considered to contribute to the strategy for Sweden's development cooperation with Bolivia 2021-2025,

The general objective of the Project is:
Contribute to the construction of a democratic, inclusive and equitable culture committed to the full exercise of the human rights of women and LGBTI populations in Bolivian society, through processes of awareness, information, social articulation and knowledge management from the different approaches of masculinities, gender and human rights.
Specific objetive is:
Institutions defending human rights, women's organizations, social organizations, masculinities movements and national networks contribute, exchange and implement work methodologies with men to reduce gender violence and machismos for the construction of more inclusive and democratic societies.

title.narrative: Agreement Accion por los Derechos Humanos

description.narrative: Results achieved: In the strategy line of training aimed at raising awareness and information about sentient masculinities and prevention of violence against women in both the 2022 and 2023 administrations, more than 80 institutions, CSOs and social organizations have been reached at the national level. 25% have been international cooperation organizations and 45% public entities and 30% organizations, groups and human rights activists. It is important to note that actions have also been carried out in educational units, universities and other public spaces where the educational model on coaching in sentipensante masculinities has been presented. Sammanfattande resultatuppdatering Conclusion on Performance Contribution ID: 13725 2 (9) Throughout 2023, more than 3,700 people have participated, of which 52% have been men and 48% women. Of the total number of people, 55% have been populations of civil society organizations, where youth, diversity, women, and indigenous organizations have an important weight, and 45% have been officials of public entities (FELCV, FELCN, UTOP, Radio Patrulla 110, National Directorate of Human Rights Police, USFA, Rural and Border Police, Transit, Comprehensive Police Station (EPI), Judges, Prosecutors, DNAs, SLIMs and Secretariats of Children and Gender, Ministries, SelfEmployed Companies, National Police, Ombudsman People) and representatives of international civil society entities and organizations. In relation of output 1. The educationaltraining and awarenessraising and information proposal is enabling men and women to acquire skills and abilities to manage emotions and reflect on the hegemonic masculinities and machismos that we all carry incorporated into our daily actions. This educational model in coaching in sentipensantes masculinities in addition to contributing to the critical reflection of gender relations within the patriarchy from the approach of sentipensantes masculinities, human rights and gender, proposes establishing active listening spaces in groups of men and mixed where different populations can reflect on hegemonic masculinities, machismos, power relations and gender violence directed especially at women and LGTBIQ populations. 120 men and women from public entities are being sensitized, informed and trained in sentient masculinities, gender focus and the right to live a life without violence. 3,800 people, 45% men and 55% women, have been part of the training, information and awareness processes of social organizations, national and subnational public entities, and national and international human rights institutions. Established work agreements with the Plurinational Service for Women and Depatriarchalization (SEPMUD), Confederation of Indigenous Peasant Women of Bolivia Bartolina Sisa, Mi Teleférico, UPEA Social Work Career, Cimarronas, Licas Tarija, Warmis fighting and Working, CONBOJUV , Promoters for the Departmental Youth Law, Franz Tamayo Private University and Municipal Youth Council of El Alto. Within the framework of the work agreement with SEPMUD, it has been defined to present the Coaching in sentipensantes masculinities model as proposals for awareness and information to public officials from the EGPP.
